Subject: Renewal forecasting / churn flags — request for micro-updates

Hi Karthik,

Quick one — our Q2 renewal for the Redwood deployment is coming up and my finance team needs a concise handoff: an updated ARR commitment number plus any churn indicators you currently see. We surfaced a few usage dips from Feb that we'd like context on (monthly active key-count down ~17%). Can you share: 1) the latest forecasted renewal ARR, 2) any accounts you flag as "elevated churn risk" with reasons, and 3) a brief timeline for next steps?

If easier, we can hop on a 20-min call — I'm available Friday morning PT.

Thanks —
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Procurement, Echo Health
phone: +1 415-555-0199

PS: attaching the extract our FinOps team pulled for context.
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@echohealth.com>, Echo Health Finance <finance@echohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal forecasting / churn flags — request for micro-updates

Hi Liam — thanks for the heads-up and the extract. I can give a short handoff now and follow up with the workbook and a compact action list. Key points: 

- Current best forecasted renewal ARR (baseline): $1.32M annualized. This reflects a conservative renewal probability mix after adjusting for lower Feb usage in three mid-market accounts.
- Elevated churn risk (accounts we are monitoring):
  * Greenway Labs (usage down, support ticket volume up; reason: completed PoC, waiting on procurement)
  * Meridian Care (spike of token errors the week of Feb 11; investigating client-side integration)
  * NorthBridge Clinics (requesting pricing review; contract up in 45 days)
- Near-term mitigation steps: run targeted outreach this week (CS + AE play), prioritize Greenway for an executive call, and offer a 30-day usage analysis report to Meridian.

I'll circulate a short worksheet (churn_indicator_matrix.xlsx) that maps indicators -> recommended ask + owner. Marissa, Naomi — can you please own outreach sequencing and the quick usage analysis respectively?

Liam — if a call helps, we can do Friday 9:30am PT. Otherwise, I'll send the attachments and a concise mutual action plan by EOD Thursday.

Cheers,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Echo Health renewal — micro-playbook and owners

Team — forwarding Liam's ask and my quick summary. Attaching the churn_indicator_matrix.xlsx and a Q1 micro-update PDF export. Action items (short):

1) Marissa: lead AE outreach to Greenway Labs and NorthBridge Clinics; confirm pricing ask for NorthBridge and whether a short-term holdback covers the gap. (Due: Tue 3/6 EOD)
2) Naomi: run a 30-day usage anomaly report for Meridian Care focusing on token error rates and request logs; flag anything that looks infra-related vs client integration. (Due: Mon 3/5 noon)
3) Ben: prepare the renewal forecast delta table (baseline vs downside with probability buckets) for finance; include suggested credit/discount levers if we need to salvage % of ARR. (Due: Wed 3/7)

Notes: keep outreach light and diagnostic-first — we want to collect signal, not push pricing right away. I'll coordinate the Friday 9:30am PT call if Liam confirms.

Attachments: churn_indicator_matrix.xlsx (mapping), Q1_forecast_micro-updates.pdf (summary)

— Karthik
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@echohealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Echo Health Finance <finance@echohealth.com>

Karthik — thanks for the quick turnaround and clear owners. Friday 9:30am PT works for me; let's take that. For the call, our CFO would like the midpoint and downside ARR numbers up front if possible (ballpark is fine), plus a one-pager on risk drivers. If you can send the baseline vs downside table before the call, that will make the meeting productive.

I'll be on the call with our procurement and finance leads. Looking forward to the usage report for Meridian — that will help decide whether to escalate to platform engineering.

Best —
Liam
